cadence.label: Retainer cadences
cadence.description: The recurring period a retainer's intervention quota resets over. Applies to retainer Projects only.

concepts.label: Monthly
concepts.definition: Quota resets each month

concepts.label: Quarterly
concepts.definition: Quota resets each quarter

effort.label: Effort estimates
effort.description: How long a Recommendation is expected to take to execute — a categorical horizon, not a score. Scored dimensions (impact, risk, time-to-value) belong on a TacticAssessment via onDimension; this is the delivery-side estimate an operator plans a cycle around.

concepts.label: Hours
concepts.definition: Done inside a working day

concepts.label: A day or two
concepts.definition: A short, bounded piece of work

concepts.label: Weeks
concepts.definition: A multi-week deliverable

concepts.label: A quarter
concepts.definition: A programme, not a task

engagementType.label: Engagement types
engagementType.description: The shape of a Project's contract — the discriminator for how its scope is expressed. A retainer caps interventions per recurring period (cadence); a one-off caps them over a fixed run (durationDays). The intervention quota is common to both and always required: a scope of work with no ceiling is not a scope.

concepts.label: One-off
concepts.definition: Fixed run; the quota covers durationDays

concepts.label: Retainer
concepts.definition: Recurring; the quota resets every cadence period

epistemicLayer.label: Epistemic layers
epistemicLayer.description: The six kinds of claim a WEO term can make, in order from bedrock to governance. The annotation property types TERMS; publishing the six here as a scheme gives a consumer tagging INSTANCES the same six values under one IRI each. Whether WEO itself should own an instance-level layer property is a separate decision this scheme does not make.

concepts.label: Entity
concepts.definition: A durable identity — a website, a page, a term, a brand

concepts.label: Episode
concepts.definition: Something that happened at a time; immutable once finished — a crawl, a captured response, an experiment

concepts.label: Observation
concepts.definition: A measured fact, grounded in a standard or an API contract

concepts.label: Derivation
concepts.definition: Model or algorithm output; carries method, model and confidence

concepts.label: Interpretation
concepts.definition: A labeled claim — a diagnosed gap, a recommendation, an objective

concepts.label: Norm
concepts.definition: A standing rule about a class of cases — a Practice

execution.label: Who executes
execution.description: Who does the work a Recommendation calls for. ours spends the engagement's intervention allowance; advised does not, because advisory work is not agency capacity. This is the delivery-side half of the scope gate: requiresCapability says whether the work is possible, execution says whose hours it costs.

concepts.label: Client does it
concepts.definition: Advisory — outside the allowance; the client executes

concepts.label: We do it
concepts.definition: Spends the engagement allowance

experimentStatus.label: Experiment lifecycle
experimentStatus.description: Lifecycle of an Experiment, as weo:status on that node. unmeasurable covers two arrivals with one word — an operator cleared the measured set, or the website has no search-performance history to measure against; the record says which.

concepts.label: Measuring
concepts.definition: Inside its results window; observations still arriving

concepts.label: Concluded
concepts.definition: Window closed; an Outcome is recorded and immutable

concepts.label: Cancelled
concepts.definition: Stopped before conclusion, with a reason

concepts.label: Not measurable
concepts.definition: No usable baseline or observation stream

gapType.label: Gap types
gapType.description: The kinds of Gap a Diagnostic can reveal, in the priority order the structural comparison states them. Five structural findings, four deep-content axes (a missing FAQ block, a missing spec table, a missing certification and a page written for the wrong buyer stage are four different interventions drawn from different tactic categories), four non-structural findings, and one site-level finding. There is deliberately no backlink value: the referring-domain profile is a separate remit. domain_authority_deficit is not that — it is the finding that the page fight is already winnable and the SITE is what is losing.
gapType.source: if-control-center packages/contracts/src/gap.ts (GAP_TYPES, GAP_TYPE_LABELS, GAP_TYPE_HINTS) · launch-guardian LG_GAP_TYPES

concepts.label: No page for this topic
concepts.definition: They hold a page for this topic and we have none

concepts.label: Orphaned page
concepts.definition: Strong content almost nothing links to — a promotion problem, not a content one

concepts.label: Buried in the architecture
concepts.definition: Served from too deep in the site against a top-level page

concepts.label: Thin page
concepts.definition: Comparable page, materially less on it

concepts.label: Split across pages
concepts.definition: Several of our pages share this topic and compete with each other

concepts.label: Missing subtopic
concepts.definition: Questions their page answers and ours does not

concepts.label: Missing format asset
concepts.definition: Specs, comparison tables, calculators, downloads or schema we lack

concepts.label: Missing proof
concepts.definition: Named projects, data or certifications we do not show

concepts.label: Buyer-stage mismatch
concepts.definition: Theirs is written for a different stage of the buyer journey

concepts.label: Visibility shortfall
concepts.definition: Estimated traffic we are losing on this topic

concepts.label: Position climb
concepts.definition: We already rank here — this is a climb on an asset we own

concepts.label: Ranking without clicks
concepts.definition: On page one, drawing impressions and no clicks — snippet and intent work

concepts.label: Project footprint
concepts.definition: They rank for named projects that represent a portfolio asset

concepts.label: Outranked by the site, not the page
concepts.definition: Our page holds up, but their domain outranks ours — a satellite, not a page edit

gapVerdict.label: Gap verdicts
gapVerdict.description: A topic's disposition on the scoreboard — the operator-facing decision about a Gap. Carried by exactly one finding per topic per analysis: a verdict is a property of the topic, and a topic's other findings carry none rather than repeating a disposition the analysis did not reach for them.

concepts.label: Attack
concepts.definition: They hold a strong page and we have none or a weak one

concepts.label: Defend
concepts.definition: Comparable, and our own trend is falling

concepts.label: Fix first
concepts.definition: Our content is strong but orphaned, split or buried

concepts.label: Hold
concepts.definition: Ours is the stronger page

concepts.label: Ignore
concepts.definition: Off-ICP or unwinnable

intervention.label: Interventions — the service catalogue
intervention.description: The categories of work an agency can deploy — its service catalogue, as WEO's Intervention taxonomy. A Tactic is inIntervention exactly one of these; a Project's contract scope is expressed over them. Each carries who controls the work (agency, client, or the community) and a typical lead time, because both decide whether a recommendation is deliverable or advisory. The experiment ledger keys the same categories by numeric code; that crosswalk is the ledger's own catalogue, not restated here.
intervention.source: weo-graph-kit seed/framework.cypher (InterventionType) · if-event-ledger tactic_category (numeric codes, served by the ledger's catalog endpoint)

concepts.label: Brand / entity operations
concepts.definition: Entity truth, author entities, brand accuracy across the web
concepts.note: category consulting · controlled by client · lead time variable

concepts.label: Community mobilization
concepts.definition: The floor beneath the floor — only works if the counter-narrative already exists unprompted
concepts.note: category community · controlled by community · lead time 8+ weeks

concepts.label: Content optimization / refresh
concepts.definition: Revising pages the client already holds
concepts.note: category content optimization · controlled by agency · lead time 1–2 weeks

concepts.label: Third-party editorial placement
concepts.definition: Earned media: a placement on a third-party editorial surface
concepts.note: category earned media · controlled by agency · lead time 2–4 weeks

concepts.label: Local / community placement
concepts.definition: Earned media: a placement on a local or community surface
concepts.note: category earned media · controlled by agency · lead time 2–4 weeks

concepts.label: Onsite content advisory
concepts.definition: Content direction the client's own team executes
concepts.note: category consulting · controlled by client · lead time variable

concepts.label: Owned content creation
concepts.definition: New pages or assets on the client's own site
concepts.note: category content creation · controlled by agency · lead time 4–8 weeks

concepts.label: Technical onsite work
concepts.definition: Site infrastructure, rendering, schema, performance — executed by the client's engineers
concepts.note: category consulting · controlled by client · lead time variable

magnitudeUnit.label: Magnitude units
magnitudeUnit.description: The unit of a Gap's size, where the finding IS a size. A magnitude is never rendered bare. sessions_estimated names the CTR-model provenance in the unit itself, so a derived session figure can never render as a measured one. referring_domains counts domains pointing at a site and is deliberately a separate unit from inlinks, which counts a crawl's internal links — one unit for both would invite a comparison between them.

concepts.label: Clicks
concepts.definition: {n} clicks

concepts.label: Impressions
concepts.definition: {n} impressions

concepts.label: Internal links
concepts.definition: {n} internal links, counted by a crawl

concepts.label: Keywords
concepts.definition: {n} keywords

concepts.label: Positions
concepts.definition: {n} positions

concepts.label: Referring domains
concepts.definition: {n} referring domains pointing at the site

concepts.label: Sessions (estimated)
concepts.definition: ≈{n} sessions/mo, derived by a CTR model — never a measured figure

concepts.label: Words
concepts.definition: {n} words

objectiveMetric.label: Objective metrics
objectiveMetric.description: The metrics a MetricTarget can be set on. Half the vocabulary is lower-is-better — position and rank_absolute are 1-based ranks — so a target's direction is DERIVED from the metric, never client input; a shared +20% across metrics would silently ask for a rank 20% worse. The note on each concept records direction and unit.

concepts.label: Clicks
concepts.definition: Search clicks over the window
concepts.note: direction up · unit count · source GSC

concepts.label: CTR
concepts.definition: Clickthrough rate over the window
concepts.note: direction up · unit percent · source GSC

concepts.label: Est. traffic value
concepts.definition: Estimated traffic value
concepts.note: direction up · unit currency · source DataForSEO

concepts.label: Impressions
concepts.definition: Search impressions over the window
concepts.note: direction up · unit count · source GSC

concepts.label: Avg position
concepts.definition: Average SERP position over the window
concepts.note: direction down · unit rank · source GSC

concepts.label: Rank
concepts.definition: Absolute rank from a rank tracker
concepts.note: direction down · unit rank · source DataForSEO

outcomeResult.label: Outcome results
outcomeResult.description: Whether an Outcome moved. A regression IS significant: result answers did this move, and the lift's sign answers which way. The labels must not smuggle a direction in.

concepts.label: Inconclusive
concepts.definition: Could not be judged — see resultReason

concepts.label: No change
concepts.definition: Measured, and it did not move

concepts.label: Moved
concepts.definition: The measured change clears the significance bar, in either direction

outcomeResultReason.label: Why an outcome was inconclusive
outcomeResultReason.description: Why an Outcome could not be read cleanly. The two confounder reasons read differently on purpose: co_intervention keeps its lift and names the rows it shares attribution with; confounded_external records none. below_volume_floor and no_page_data are not the same sentence — the second asserts an absence, the first says there is data and not yet enough of it.

concepts.label: No search history before this shipped
concepts.definition: Nothing to compare against

concepts.label: Not enough traffic to judge
concepts.definition: The page has data, and not yet enough for a percentage to mean anything

concepts.label: Shared with other work of ours
concepts.definition: Another of our interventions touched the same pages in the window; lift is kept and attribution is shared

concepts.label: Something outside our work changed the page
concepts.definition: An external event confounds the window; no lift is recorded

concepts.label: No search data for this page
concepts.definition: A complete window with no rows at all on the address

concepts.label: Waiting on a reading
concepts.definition: No qualifying rank snapshot has arrived yet

concepts.label: Window still filling
concepts.definition: The results window has not closed

practiceKind.label: Practice kinds
practiceKind.description: How a Practice acts on a candidate recommendation. Kept as a small controlled value rather than a subclass.

concepts.label: Guardrail
concepts.definition: Veto a matching candidate

concepts.label: Guidance
concepts.definition: Attach a caveat; change nothing

concepts.label: Preference
concepts.definition: Reorder a matching candidate

practiceOutcome.label: What a Practice did
practiceOutcome.description: What a Practice did to a candidate when it fired — the value carried on the appliedPractice audit edge. One outcome per practiceKind: a guardrail vetoes, a preference reranks, guidance caveats.

concepts.label: Flagged
concepts.definition: Guidance attached a caveat and changed nothing else

concepts.label: Reordered
concepts.definition: A preference moved the candidate up or down

concepts.label: Blocked
concepts.definition: A guardrail removed the candidate

practiceSource.label: Practice provenance
practiceSource.description: Where a Practice came from — the confidence ratchet. authored stands on a human's authority; claimed ships low-confidence with a halfLife and decays unless experiments promote it; learned is earned from the experiment ledger, and its confidence ratchets with Outcomes. One class holds a firm SOP and a fragile claim without conflating their trust.
practiceSource.source: weo-strategy.ttl (weo:source, on a Practice) · if-control-center PRACTICE_SOURCES

concepts.label: Authored
concepts.definition: A human SOP or best-practice — high standing, durable

concepts.label: Claimed
concepts.definition: An unproven assertion — ships low-confidence, decays over its halfLife unless promoted

concepts.label: Learned
concepts.definition: Earned from the experiment ledger; confidence ratchets with Outcomes

practiceStatus.label: Practice lifecycle
practiceStatus.description: Lifecycle of a Practice, as weo:status on that node. A proposed Practice is visible but does not fire; superseding one deprecates it — retired, never deleted, so the record of what it vetoed survives.
practiceStatus.source: weo-strategy.ttl (weo:status, on a Practice) · if-control-center PRACTICE_STATUSES

concepts.label: Proposed
concepts.definition: Visible; does not fire

concepts.label: Active
concepts.definition: Fires on matching candidates

concepts.label: Deprecated
concepts.definition: Superseded; retained for the audit trail

priority.label: Priority tiers
priority.description: The priority a Recommendation is issued at. Three tiers, read as a horizon rather than a severity: now, next, later. Where another system speaks critical/high/medium/low, map critical and high to P0, medium to P1, low to P2 — the mapping is documented here so it is not re-decided per consumer.

concepts.label: Now
concepts.definition: Do this in the current cycle

concepts.label: Next
concepts.definition: Queued behind the current cycle

concepts.label: Later
concepts.definition: Worth doing; not yet scheduled

recommendationStatus.label: Recommendation execution lifecycle
recommendationStatus.description: The execution lifecycle of a Recommendation, as weo:status on that node. pending, in_progress and blocked are the OPEN states — they still consume an engagement's intervention quota. The delivery board buckets these five into recommended / active / blocked / measuring / completed, where measuring is a completed recommendation still inside its results window; that bucketing is a derived view, not a second vocabulary. A system with a skipped state maps it to cancelled.

concepts.label: Proposed
concepts.definition: Issued and not yet started; counts as open work

concepts.label: In progress
concepts.definition: Being executed; counts as open work

concepts.label: Blocked
concepts.definition: Cannot proceed — a dependency, an approval, or a client direction; still counts as open work

concepts.label: Cancelled
concepts.definition: Withdrawn with a recorded reason; never silently dropped

concepts.label: Done
concepts.definition: Shipped; measuring until its results window closes

targetKind.label: Target kinds
targetKind.description: How a MetricTarget's targetValue is read: as an absolute value of the metric, or as a percent change from the captured baseline.

concepts.label: Absolute
concepts.definition: targetValue is a value of the metric itself

concepts.label: Percent lift
concepts.definition: targetValue is a relative change from baseline, in the metric's better direction
